sections.content: You know *es importante que* and other value judgements with the subjunctive, and the subjunctive after emotions (*me alegra que*), from A2 Unit 27. This lesson adds *es necesario que*, *me parece bien que* and *me preocupa que* to evaluate actions and situations.

items.spanish: Es importante que escuchemos otras opiniones.
items.english: It is important that we listen to other opinions.
I think it is good that they participate.

items.spanish: Le preocupa que algunas decisiones afecten a quienes no participaron en el debate.
items.english: It worries her that some decisions might affect those who did not take part in the debate.

sections.content: *Le preocupa que* works like *es importante que* even though it's built differently — a verb with an indirect object rather than *es* + adjective. Any emotional or evaluative reaction to someone else's action pulls in the subjunctive.
